mapper.sql: select account_id, (select a.name from crm_account a where a.account_id = crm_account_value.account_id) as account_name, currency, member_count, booked_total, inflight_total, refund_total, net_clv, paid_total, pending_receivable, pltv_12m, acquisition_cost, case when acquisition_cost > 0 then (net_clv - acquisition_cost) / acquisition_cost else null end as roi, tier, by_treatment::text as by_treatment, last_visit_at, days_since_last_visit, calculated_at, del_flag from crm_account_value
mapper.select:
where del_flag = 0 and tier = #{tier} and net_clv >= #{minNetClv} and net_clv <= #{maxNetClv}
and exists (select 1 from crm_account a where a.account_id = crm_account_value.account_id and a.owner = #{owner})
and exists (select 1 from crm_account a where a.account_id = crm_account_value.account_id and a.org_id = #{orgId})
order by pltv_12m order by last_visit_at order by net_clv
asc desc
select distinct account_id from crm_contact where account_id is not null and account_id != '' union select account_id from crm_account where account_id is not null
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_account_value ( account_id, tenant_id, currency, member_count, booked_total, inflight_total, refund_total, net_clv, paid_total, pending_receivable, pltv_12m, acquisition_cost, tier, by_treatment, last_visit_at, days_since_last_visit, calculated_at, del_flag ) VALUES ( #{accountId}, #{tenantId}, #{currency}, #{memberCount}, #{bookedTotal}, #{inflightTotal}, #{refundTotal}, #{netClv}, #{paidTotal}, #{pendingReceivable}, #{pltv12m}, #{acquisitionCost}, #{tier}, #{byTreatment}::jsonb, #{lastVisitAt}, #{daysSinceLastVisit}, #{calculatedAt}, 0 ) ON CONFLICT (account_id) DO UPDATE SET tenant_id = EXCLUDED.tenant_id, currency = EXCLUDED.currency, member_count = EXCLUDED.member_count, booked_total = EXCLUDED.booked_total, inflight_total = EXCLUDED.inflight_total, refund_total = EXCLUDED.refund_total, net_clv = EXCLUDED.net_clv, paid_total = EXCLUDED.paid_total, pending_receivable = EXCLUDED.pending_receivable, pltv_12m = EXCLUDED.pltv_12m, acquisition_cost = EXCLUDED.acquisition_cost, tier = EXCLUDED.tier, by_treatment = EXCLUDED.by_treatment, last_visit_at = EXCLUDED.last_visit_at, days_since_last_visit = EXCLUDED.days_since_last_visit, calculated_at = EXCLUDED.calculated_at
